sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A shrub or small tree of tropical Africa, 1.5–15 m tall depending on conditions. Its evergreen leaves, 20–150 cm long and 2–12 cm wide, cluster at the tops of stems.

sections.title: Flowering and fruit
sections.text: Fragrant cream to greenish flowers are borne in panicles. They develop into berries that ripen orange to red.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: The plant’s saponins can be toxic to pets, including cats and dogs.
